sourceSelection.description: The 20 URLs below are the identical, unmodified pinned-URL list already checked into experiments/html_main_content/fetch_held_out.sh (issue #229/#26's trafilatura held-out corpus), pinned at trafilatura commit 1e31e3e9eb2e4f6fbfd4bc04355bc74005a780e6. That script never vendors page bytes into git; it fetches transiently for test-only comparator use. This corpus is a SEPARATE, new, permanently-checked-in mechanism (issue #315's own owner-accepted redistribution risk), reusing only the same URL list as its source of what to fetch -- not fetch_held_out.sh's transient-fetch mechanism itself, and fetch_held_out.sh is unmodified by this change.

fetchMethods.live: Direct HTTP(S) GET of the live URL (curl, one request per page, a generic browser-identifying User-Agent, redirects followed), performed once on the fetch date above. Byte content reflects each page's live state on the fetch date.
fetchMethods.trafilatura-pinned-cache: The live URL no longer resolves to the original page as of the fetch date (link rot: HTTP 404, DNS failure, or a TLS certificate now issued to an unrelated host -- see 'linkRotFindings' below). For these pages only, the bytes instead come from adbar/trafilatura's own bundled test corpus at the exact pinned commit above -- the SAME trust/provenance source experiments/html_main_content/fetch_held_out.sh already relies on for these same URLs, just read as a stored file instead of a live request. Each such artifact entry below cites the exact repository path (tests/eval/<file> or tests/cache/<file>) the bytes came from. This is still real, unmodified, third-party page content; it is simply an older, archived copy (trafilatura's own eval-corpus snapshot) rather than the page's current live state.

fetchOutcomeSummary.note: All 20 originally pinned URLs are represented in this corpus. 14 were fetched live from their original URL on the fetch date above. The other 6 have suffered real link rot since trafilatura's own eval corpus was assembled (dead pages, a dead domain, and a domain now serving an unrelated TLS certificate -- named plainly, not euphemized) and were instead backfilled from adbar/trafilatura's own pinned-commit test corpus, the same source experiments/html_main_content/fetch_held_out.sh already trusts for these exact URLs. Every artifact entry below states which of the two fetch methods produced it; see 'linkRotFindings' for the exact link-rot evidence recorded for each of the 6.
